acceptable_hostkeys.description: List of acceptable host keys (fingerprints or base64 blobs). Overrides automated management.

allow_agent.description: Allow use of an authentication agent (override saved session).

append_log.description: Append to existing log file if it exists.

background_color.description: Background color for normal text. Supports X11 color names or hex.

bold_background_color.description: Background color for bold reverse-video text.

bold_foreground_color.description: Foreground color for bold text (if BoldAsColour is 1 or 2).

charset.description: Character set encoding for the session (e.g., UTF-8, ISO-8859-1).

cursor_background_color.description: Background color for text under the cursor (cursor color).

cursor_foreground_color.description: Foreground color for text under the cursor.

disable_agent_forwarding.description: Disable SSH agent forwarding (overrides enable if both true, prioritize enable).

display.description: X display name to use for opening the PuTTY window. Leave empty for default.

dynamic_port.description: Port number to listen on for dynamic port forwarding (SOCKS).

enable_pseudo_terminal.description: Allocate a pseudo-terminal at the server end.

font_bold.description: Font name for bold text. Ignored if BoldAsColour is 1.

font_name.description: Font name for normal text. e.g., 'fixed', 'Monospace 10'.

force_ip_version.description: Force IPv4 (4) or IPv6 (6). Leave empty for auto.

foreground_color.description: Foreground color for normal text. Supports X11 color names or hex.

geometry.description: Terminal window size in rows and columns. e.g., '80x24'. Leave empty to use default.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server to connect to.

key_file.description: Path to the private key file (PPK format).

local_forwards.description: List of local port forwarding rules. Format: 'srcport:desthost:destport'. e.g., ['8080:localhost:80'].

log_file.description: Path to file for logging all terminal output.

no_agent.description: Don't try to use an authentication agent.

no_trivial_auth.description: Disconnect from servers that accept authentication without challenge.

overwrite_log.description: Discard existing log file if it exists.

port.description: Port number to connect to on the remote host.

protocol.description: Connection protocol: ssh, telnet, rlogin, supdup, raw, serial.

proxy_command.description: Command string to use as a proxy (supports %host and %port).

remote_forwards.description: List of remote port forwarding rules. Format: 'srcport:desthost:destport'. e.g., ['8080:localhost:80'].

saved_session.description: Name of a saved PuTTY session to load.

scrollback_lines.description: Number of lines of scrollback to save.

serial_config.description: Serial port configuration string. e.g., '9600,n,8,1' for 9600 baud, no parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit.

show_scrollbar.description: Whether to display the scroll bar.

ssh_log_file.description: Path to file for logging decoded SSH protocol details.

ssh_protocol_version.description: SSH protocol version to use: 1 or 2.

ssh_raw_log_file.description: Path to file for logging raw SSH encrypted packet data.

window_title.description: Initial title of the terminal window.
